text: This bridge tore itself apart in a forty mile an hour wind.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge opened in July nineteen forty.
asr: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge opened in July 1940.

text: Its deck was so thin and solid that steady wind made it twist, harder and harder, until it ripped apart four months later.
Engineers learned that wind can shake a bridge to pieces.
That's why modern bridges are tested in wind tunnels first.
